purpose: Teach: メタデータ/主眼/採る/価額/常設/工学科/多面/製作所

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ファイルのメタデータを整理しろ
lines.en: Organize the file metadata across the company.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands with weight. No softening, no pause for objection. The tone of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新事業の主眼を顧客満足度に置きます
lines.en: Understood. We'll prioritize customer satisfaction in the new venture.
lines.style: Steady, formal acknowledgment. Slight nod on the opening word. Even pace, measured delivery. Shows he's absorbed the instruction and is already thinking ahead to execution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人材を全国から採るぞ
lines.en: We're recruiting talent from across the country.
lines.style: Firm directive. Light emphasis on the scope — 'across the country' lands with intention. Leans forward slightly. No room for negotiation in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。価額表示の規則を統一しました
lines.en: Understood. We've standardized the pricing display rules.
lines.style: Calm report, not defensive. Matter-of-fact delivery showing work already done. Steady eye contact. Efficient — no elaboration, just the fact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本社一階に常設の展示スペースを作れ
lines.en: Set up a permanent display space on the first floor of headquarters.
lines.style: Direct instruction, cleanly articulated. Slight pause after 'headquarters' to let the location register. Expectation of compliance embedded in the tone, not forced.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工学科卒の社員を技術部門に配属します
lines.en: Understood. We're assigning engineering graduates to the technical department.
lines.style: Straightforward update. Confident delivery without rush. Shows initiative within the scope of the directive. Stands at ease, present but not overeager.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、多面的に市場を分析しろ
lines.en: Conduct multifaceted market analysis across the company.
lines.style: Measured authority. Emphasis on 'multifaceted' — specific enough to be non-negotiable. Deliberate pacing. The tone of someone who expects thoroughness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製作所の工程改善を進めております
lines.en: Understood. We're advancing process improvements at the manufacturing facility.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly fuller than previous updates. Shows momentum and completion. Steady, assured delivery. The closing note of a productive exchange.
